description: Share of orders delivered within the 2-hour customer promise, by city and by hour of day. Customer clock (from order placed), per the delivery promise doc. Simulates the live ops dashboard.
notes: Indore evening dip (5-8 pm IST) aligns with the rider capacity constraints described in the Indore BRD operating realities.
Indore takes no orders late evening because partner stores close at 9 pm; other cities serve later hours.
Rain-mode days are included; excluding them lifts Indore to 0.861.
